construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation created for this isolated build

shared_schema.input: synthetic=true; protection_key (16+ characters); interval_minutes (1..1440); fixed safety_rules; preferences (nonnegative metric weights, positive total); nonempty candidates; optional case-insensitive name query
shared_schema.candidate: unique name; monthly_cost_usd; grid_assets (asset_id, kind=substation|meter|device, critical boolean); topology (from,to); meter_csv; telemetry_json; outage_reports
shared_schema.meter_csv: Exact header device_id,timestamp,consumption,unit. Timezone-aware contiguous intervals; Wh/kWh/MWh. Every meter has the same timeline, also shared across products.
shared_schema.telemetry_json: synthetic=true; samples covering each asset exactly once with asset_id, availability_percent (0..100), emissions (nonnegative value, gCO2e|kgCO2e|tCO2e, nonempty source). Values describe the shared observation window.
shared_schema.outage_report: asset_id, life_safety boolean, essential_service boolean, priority=emergency|urgent|routine
shared_schema.output: status, schema_version, synthetic, normalized products (meter_readings, grid_assets, topology, outage_reports, sourced emissions), side_by_side metric columns, ranking with scores and weighted utilities, safety_rules, method and demonstration notice
shared_schema.errors: CLI prints one sanitized JSON status=error object and exits 2 for validation, parsing and file errors; success exits 0
shared_schema.validation: One shared deterministic comparison pipeline validates schema, references, units, coverage, finite numeric values and safety rules before searching or ranking. Unknown object fields are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated candidate entities -> unit-normalized attributes and protected entity references
Normalized records -> optional name filter -> side-by-side columns -> weighted preference ranking

behavior.ranking: Weighted min-max utility among matched candidates; lower cost, energy, emissions and outage risk preferred; higher arithmetic-mean availability preferred. Constant metrics contribute utility 1. Score rounded to 8 decimals; score ties sorted by case-insensitive name.
behavior.outages: Life safety overrides essential service: emergency; otherwise essential service: urgent; otherwise routine. Incorrect supplied priority is rejected. Risk is maximum severity 0..3, where 0 means no reports.
behavior.protection: All asset IDs replaced with keyed HMAC-SHA256 references (24 hex characters). Raw identifiers and the key are prohibited in public output, including free-text fields. Errors never echo inputs. Caller must keep the key secret; fixture key is deliberately public synthetic data.
behavior.fixtures: Explicitly synthetic fictitious two-node grid alternatives; winter evening heating-load interval consumption; sourced synthetic emissions.
behavior.aggregation: Consumption and emissions summed over assets; availability is an unweighted asset mean. Monthly cost is a separate comparison attribute, not extrapolated from the short observation window.

included: Synthetic meter CSV and SCADA-style telemetry JSON
Demonstrative critical identifier protection and safety validation

test_outcomes.cli: passed: example input produced one JSON object with status ok and exit code 0; CLI failure cases returned status error and exit code 2
